description: Set the review link (for example your Google review page, https only) and how many days after an invoice is paid the customer gets one email asking for a review (owner only). No link means no email. Default 1 day; 0 turns it off. Review emails show the shop name and mailing_address in the footer, so a link can only be set once the shop has a mailing address (send it here).
name: shops_setReviewRequest
